tool_args.rationale: Fit the archived sink-modulated saturation law and select its square-root or linear branch by training residual. The gradient span and six observations permit estimation of the three effective coefficients; fresh confirmation will test generalization.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archived two-layer siphon directly matches the observed concave response and sink dependence; fresh confirmation can test it before adding complexity.
The acquired branch observation adds discrimination, and there is no evidence requiring a coupled time-dependent ODE.
It does not discriminate the relevant mechanisms.
